tagline: Creek Road and a lake made to hold floods.
intro: Creek Road carries the Lake Wilhelm byway into part of Maurice K. Goddard State Park. Sandy Creek was dammed here after years of flooding, making a reservoir whose shores are shared by the park and adjoining game lands.

The water draws anglers and migrating waterfowl; the surrounding woods shelter pileated woodpeckers. Goddard, the park’s namesake, worked toward putting a state park within twenty-five miles of every Pennsylvanian. This one grew from the practical business of holding back a creek.

moments.title: Lake Wilhelm marina
moments.text: Boat launches open onto a warm-water fishery, while osprey and bald eagles scan the lake for fish.

moments.title: Maurice K. Goddard State Park
moments.text: Beyond the water, pileated woodpeckers inhabit the woods and bluebirds make their homes in the park’s old fields.
